_comment: Where the phones of this distribution look for updates, and what they may contact.
A fork or a private catalog points lock.url and lock.heartbeatUrl at its own lock.
allowedHosts is a decision, not a summary of the lock: make check refuses a lock
with a URL outside it, so the daily refresh cannot widen where a phone connects.
Add a host here, in a pull request, when a source needs it.
